messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: gpu-pool-shard-3: KV-prefetch memory pressure above 92% — signal: CUDA_MEM_ALLOC_FAIL. Severity: P1. Thread created at 2951236789
samira oncall: acked PagerDuty (PD-3245). I'm on it. ETA 10m
mike infra: looking at aggregate mem metrics + nvtop. Any customer-facing errors?
jess product: support reports spike in inference 502s for customer-acme, started ~11:03 UTC
anya eng-sre: checking pool logs: repeated `CUDAMalloc: out of memory` and slab_reclaim loops. Prefetch spikes correlate with batch size increase from new rollout
samira oncall: rolling back prefetch toggle on pool config for shard-3: `rbctl set pool/gpu-prefetch=false --shard=3` (running)
incident-bot: command accepted, config push started
mike infra: I see eviction events on qworker-12, qworker-14. Starting controlled evict of low-priority jobs to free KV cache
samira oncall: applied soft-evict marker to low-priority queues, ramping over 30s
jess product: confirming customer-acme latency now 1.2s to 8s, but 502s reduced from 40% to 5% for sample endpoints
anya eng-sre: log tail from shard-3:
```
[11:05:21] kvcache.cc:prefetch(): prefetch size=12MB -> alloc failed
[11:05:21] cuda_allocator.cc:alloc_async(): returned cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[11:05:22] slab_reclaim.cc:started reclaim loop
```
mike infra: GPU mem freed ~6.4GB after soft-evict, pool utilization dropped to 78%
samira oncall: initiating lossless-fallback on shard-3 to CPU: `rbctl set pool/shard-3/fallback=cpu-lossless --timeout=3s` — this will keep in-flight requests but much slower
incident-bot: fallback command queued
jess product: notify CS that ACME may see slower responses but no errors. I'll post status to status.redwood.ai
mike infra: running `nvidia-smi pmon -c 5` to watch real time, and scaling up dedicated spare nodes `infractl scale pool=gpu-spare +2`
anya eng-sre: adding temporary rate-limit for prefetch traffic: `rlctl annotate route=/prefetch weight=0.4` — will cut incoming prefetches
samira oncall: PD ack still held; I'm going to escalate to oncall-2 if we don't get stable in next 10m @mike
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-3245 acknowledged by samira oncall at 2951236792
mike infra: spare nodes are provisioning, one available in 45s
jess product: ACME CS notified, they accepted slower fallback, will monitor
anya eng-sre: spike seems tied to canary job that suddenly upped prefetch from 2->12 per request; creating rollback PR now
samira oncall: rollback PR merged and deploy started
incident-bot: deploy-bot: rolling back service `canary-preloader` to v2.9.8 -> v2.9.7
mike infra: after rollback, steady GPU mem utilization trending down to 62% across shard-3
jess product: ACME 502s back to baseline, latency back to ~300-600ms. Customer impact mitigated
samira oncall: handing off to night oncall `mike infra` in 28m. I'll stay on watcher until then. Will leave notes in incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-03-kv-prefetch
mike infra: got it, will monitor autoscale + fallback revert in 1h
samira oncall: closing PD if stable for 30m. For now keep thread open. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-3245 status: resolved at 2951236845 by samira oncall
mike infra: ack, will follow up in postmortem tomorrow re: prefetch throttles and safer canary config
jess product: thanks team. I'll send customer update and CC ops
